neighbours.label: the piece that follows a split-off ' can' at the start of a word (can|yons, can|jear, can|ister, can|ard), as against can- words that are a single token
fire: Rafting through narrow canyons is popular in the summer.
En la tienda puedes canjear los cupones por regalos.
The firefighter carried a heavy oxygen canister on his back.
At the bistro we ordered roast canard with cherries.
Para el postre añade un poco de canela y azúcar.
My grandmother taught us to play canasta on rainy days.
Un pequeño canario cantaba en la ventana de la cocina.
Some tours combine hiking with canyoning in the gorges.
quiet: Rafting through narrow valleys is popular in the summer.
En la tienda puedes cambiar los cupones por regalos.
The firefighter carried a heavy canvas bag on his back.
At the bistro we ordered roast chicken by the canal.
Para el postre añade un poco de miel y azúcar.
My grandmother taught us to paddle a canoe on calm days.
Un pequeño pájaro cantaba en la ventana de la cocina.
Some tours combine hiking with a walk under the forest canopy.
